主要内容: On August 10, 2016, Medallion Financial Corp purchased 17,000 shares of common stock at $5.78 per share, totaling $98,277, under its Current Stock Repurchase Program. As of August 10, 2016, $23,945,241 remains available for future repurchases. Since the inception of its original stock repurchase program in November 2003, a total of 2,646,125 shares have been repurchased at a cost of $23,516,497, for an average cost of $8.89 per share. The repurchase program is part of the company's corporate action strategy to manage its capital structure and shareholder value.
